title: רבה מפרזיקא
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Rabbah of Parzika, to Rav Ashi. Yet Eruvin 3a; Sotah 26b; Zevahim 10b (cited here as 9b); Bava Kamma 36a have Rava of Parzika to Rav Ashi; so too Pesahim 76b. Nazir 38, end of b, has Ravina of Parzaki to Rav Ashi; this appears to be a scribal error, as is also evident in the new Talmud editions' alternative reading, Rava of Parzaki. The locator given here is Yevamot 19b. The passage is at 59b, where one checked witness reads “Rava of Parkin said to Rav Ashi.” Heilprin proposes “of Parzaki,” a form supported by the checked vocalized text. See above, Rav Aha of Pazarki; it appears they are one. Huna Mar son of Rava of Parzaki, to Rav Ashi.
